excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK RECTANGULAR lens glasses, a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jean slacks and black dress shoes.
excavation_context.stage: Air-Scribing Consolidated Sandstone Away from a Famous Frill

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1, wearing his signature black rectangular glasses, works at an indoor laboratory workbench under bright task lighting, driving a vibrating pneumatic air-scribe across a massive rock block. Under his guidance, the tan-grey fluvial sandstone breaks away cleanly to trace out the large scalloped edge of a Triceratops neck frill. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
